    Closed chains give cleaving functors from the crown category #

    A closed chain of a ray category Q is a cyclic zigzag x₀ -ρ₀→ z₀ ←σ₀- x₁ -ρ₁→ z₁ ← ⋯ ←σₘ- x₀ of nonzero morphisms whose peaks (ρᵢ, σᵢ) and valleys (σᵢ, ρᵢ₊₁) do not close to commutative triangles. It defines a functor from the crown category Cr m (RayCat.ClosedChain.functor) which is cleaving and along which every twisted multiplicative basis is untwisted. With the band modules of Cr m and the cleaving lemma, an algebra with a twisted multiplicative basis over Q is representation-infinite (RayCat.ClosedChain.not_isRepresentationFinite).

    structure LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.ClosedChain (Q : Type) [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} Q] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms Q] (m : ℕ) :
    Type

    A closed chain with m + 1 peaks.

    • x : Fin (m + 1) → Q
    • z : Fin (m + 1) → Q
    • ρ (i : Fin (m + 1)) : self.x i ⟶ self.z i
    • σ (i : Fin (m + 1)) : self.x (i + 1) ⟶ self.z i
    • ρ_ne (i : Fin (m + 1)) : self.ρ i ≠ 0
    • σ_ne (i : Fin (m + 1)) : self.σ i ≠ 0
    • peak₁ (i : Fin (m + 1)) : ¬∃ (c : self.x i ⟶ self.x (i + 1)), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp c (self.σ i) = self.ρ i
    • peak₂ (i : Fin (m + 1)) : ¬∃ (c : self.x (i + 1) ⟶ self.x i), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp c (self.ρ i) = self.σ i
    • valley₁ (i : Fin (m + 1)) : ¬∃ (c : self.z i ⟶ self.z (i + 1)), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (self.σ i) c = self.ρ (i + 1)
    • valley₂ (i : Fin (m + 1)) : ¬∃ (c : self.z (i + 1) ⟶ self.z i), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (self.ρ (i + 1)) c = self.σ i
